_comment: How a release is put together. baryovm reads this; the deploy workflow fills in localRoot and
remoteRoot at run time from the DEPLOY_* secrets, because those two are facts about your
machine and your VM rather than anything this repository should know.
Everything else here is yours to edit.
verify: if grep -q 'The API did not answer' /tmp/{{PROJECT_SLUG}}-verify.html; then echo 'the site is up but cannot reach the CMS'; exit 1; fi
